report.methodologyBody: Ua hōʻuluʻulu ʻia kēia hōʻike e TikHub Analytics Studio mai nā API kahua lehulehu a me ka TikHub DataSet. Hoʻopili ʻia nā ana i ka manawa i hana ʻia ai ka hōʻike a hiki ke loli i ka wā e ulu ai ka ʻike kumu. Hoʻopuka ʻia nā ʻāpana i hoʻohana ʻia e AI (nā wāwahi viral, ka unuhi ʻana i ka prompt) e ka LLM i hoʻonohonoho ʻia me ka hihiʻo a pono e mālama ʻia ma ke ʻano he manaʻo loiloi ma mua o ka ʻoiaʻiʻo.
report.disclaimerBody: No nā mea kuleana kumu nā ʻikepili āpau a ua hana hou ʻia ma ʻaneʻi no nā kumu loiloi wale nō. ʻAʻole hāʻawi ʻo TikHub Analytics Studio i kahi palapala hōʻoia e pili ana i ka piha a i ʻole ka pololei a ʻaʻole manaʻo i ke kuleana no nā hoʻoholo i hana ʻia ma ke kumu o kēia hōʻike. Ua pāpā ʻia ka hāʻawi hou ʻana ma waho o ka mea i manaʻo ʻia.
